front.title: Binding Agent Dialogs to WIMSE and OAuth Credentials

abstract.t: AI agents and tools that take part in a dialog carry a dialog context with each request and response. This document specifies how the dialog context is bound to WIMSE and OAuth credentials. It extends the WIMSE profile of HTTP Message Signatures, for requests and responses, and the WIMSE Proof Token, for requests, to cover the dialog context, records the dialog identifier in OAuth transaction tokens, and describes how a new dialog at a trust boundary aligns with OAuth identity chaining. A receiver can then verify who sent a request or response, which dialog it belongs to, and, for a request, what it may do, and that the answers agree.
